sources.quote: And Chisone is conditional, the cracking 8D on their 6082 material is still open.

findings.why: Chisone (SUP-C) has conditional qualification, so it may not receive new business now. Shipping BR-310 to Beinasco is a new delivery destination. No newer document shows the status was lifted.

sources.quote: Part card BR-310, roof rail bracket for the Nordhavn Fjell (PRG-Y).

findings.why: The part card names Chisone as the source for BR-310 (Nordhavn). It does not name the receiving plant, and no controlled approval record covers BR-310 from Chisone to Beinasco (PLT-BEI) for Nordhavn. The documents show no approval and no refusal, so a person must confirm whether a release exists for this plant.

findings.key: 8D cracking on Chisone 6082 material (no id given)

sources.quote: the cracking 8D on their 6082 material is still open.

findings.why: Chisone has an open cracking 8D on its 6082 material. BR-310 is made from EN AW-6082-T5, so the issue applies to this part. The 8D has no id in the documents.
